author: Solar713
quote: Worst GTA game ever made. 30 FPS is a joke, glitches, bugs, writing is atrocious, missions are repetitive, characters are boring. Dan Houser leaving Rockstar games was a death blow to this company. Dan Houser was Rockstar games. He was the architect, writer, director, creative director of all previous mainline GTA games and Red Dead 1 & 2. He was the main creative force in the company and without him Rockstar is fading. GTA’s unique art style is gone, replaced by realism at the cost of 30FPS or lower! The biting satire & social commentary is gone. The comedy is gone. The memorable characters are gone. The creative missions are gone. And there is ZERO innovation in this game. If Dan Houser was the head of this project, this game would’ve been the best GTA ever. But this game is only better than its predecessors in the graphics department, this game doesn’t excel in any other area over the previous games. Biggest disappointment ever.
